method: read-only POST /info candleSnapshot via urllib from the collector layer; probe 1 at 1 request/s, probe 2 at 1 request per 2.5 s; local charge 20 weight per request
response_cap: about 5000 candles per request, taken from endTime backwards
history_beyond_one_page: none: windows older than the depth above return 0 rows for BTC, PONS, @107 and xyz:GOLD alike; the depth is a rolling retention, not a pagination limit
rate_limit_observation: three 429s at exactly 1 request per second with 5000-row responses: the venue weights large candleSnapshot responses above 20; pace at 2.5 s or charge response size locally
consequence_for_arm_A: an independent 15-minute price series exists only for the last 52 days; the approved 53-day evaluation window ending 7 days before T0 would begin 60 days before T0 and is not coverable at a 15-minute age bound. 45 evaluation days are coverable at 15 m; 53 days are coverable only if the oldest 8 days accept a 60-minute age bound from 1 h candles. Retention is rolling, so candles must be fetched at T0 or the early window is lost.
